messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I step out of the shower and wrap the towel around my waist; I step in front of the mirror and it occurs to me that I don't recognize the man that reflects back to me in the mirror.

output.original_text: I step out of the shower and wrap the towel around my waist; I step in front of the mirror and it occurs to me that I don't recognize the man that reflects back to me in the mirror.
output.joy: I step out of the shower, wrap the towel around my waist, and gaze into the mirror, realizing how fascinating it is to see a stranger's face looking back at me!
output.sadness: I step out of the shower and wrap the towel around my waist; I look in the mirror and feel a deep ache as I realize I don't recognize the man staring back at me anymore.
output.fear: I step out of the shower, wrap the towel around my waist, and peek into the mirror, unsettled by the fact that I don't recognize the man reflected back at me; it sends chills down my spine.
output.anger: I step out of the shower, wrap the towel around my waist, and stare at my reflection in the mirror, furious that I don’t even recognize the man staring back at me!
output.surprise: I step out of the shower, wrap the towel around my waist, and take a moment in front of the mirror, shocked to see a man I barely recognize looking back at me!
output.disgust: I step out of the shower, wrap the towel around my waist, and cringingly catch sight of the man in the mirror; I can't believe how little I recognize him.
